questions.def: Extraposition moves 'that he will succeed' and uses 'it' as a placeholder.
questions.question: It is ___ that he will succeed.

questions.def: Extraposition places 'it' before 'was' to emphasize 'once'.
questions.question: ___ believed that the earth was flat.

questions.def: Extraposition requires 'it is believed' to shift the focus.
questions.question: ___ that she is honest.

questions.def: Using 'surprising' correctly reflects the unexpected nature.
questions.question: It is ___ that they are late.

questions.def: Extraposition with 'it is' correctly introduces the importance.
questions.question: ___ vital to address climate change.

questions.def: 'It is expected' uses extraposition to focus on the arrival.
questions.question: ___ that he will arrive soon.

questions.def: Extraposition with 'it was' provides a formal reporting structure.
questions.question: ___ reported that the negotiations failed.

questions.def: Extraposition emphasizes the widespread acceptance of the practice.
questions.question: ___ considered good practice.

questions.def: 'It has been proven' uses extraposition to assert a fact.
questions.question: ___ that the theorem is correct.

questions.def: 'Evident' correctly describes the state of her happiness.
questions.question: It is ___ that she is happy.

questions.def: Extraposition with 'it is' emphasizes the importance.
questions.question: ___ important to consider all options.

questions.def: 'It is assumed' utilizes extraposition for a formal tone.
questions.question: ___ that the meeting will be productive.

questions.def: 'Possible' correctly expresses the chance of them winning.
questions.question: It is ___ that they will win.

questions.def: Extraposition emphasizes widespread knowledge.
questions.question: ___ known that smoking is harmful.

questions.def: 'It has been demonstrated' states proven validity.
questions.question: ___ that the theory holds true.

questions.def: 'Clear' indicates a lack of doubt about his innocence.
questions.question: It is ___ that he is innocent.

questions.def: Extraposition with 'it is' denotes accepted behavior.
questions.question: ___ customary to tip in restaurants.

questions.def: 'It is recognized' displays awareness of needs.
questions.question: ___ that changes are necessary.

questions.def: 'Unlikely' communicates a low probability of attendance.
questions.question: It is ___ that she will attend.

questions.def: Extraposition emphasizes the need to follow directions.
questions.question: ___ essential to follow the instructions.

questions.def: 'It is reported' provides formal notification.
questions.question: ___ that the storm is approaching.

questions.def: 'Obvious' clarifies a self-evident connection.
questions.question: It is ___ that they are related.

questions.def: Extraposition emphasizes common knowledge.
questions.question: ___ generally accepted that honesty is best.

questions.def: Extraposition moves the subject to the end with 'it' as a placeholder.
questions.question: ___ believed that the evidence was compelling.

questions.def: Extraposition uses 'it' as a dummy subject to shift focus.
questions.question: ___ that the report was inaccurate.

questions.def: 'It is necessary' is the correct extraposed form here.
questions.question: To understand the problem is necessity to analyze the data.

questions.def: Extraposition with 'it' + verb (seem) introduces the information.
questions.question: ___ that the project will be delayed.

questions.def: Extraposition uses 'it' to postpone the subject to the end.
questions.question: ___ beneficial to adopt a proactive approach.

questions.def: Extraposition makes sentences flow better when the subject is complex.
questions.question: ___ that the results were inconclusive.

questions.def: Extraposition needs 'it is important that' not 'is important that'.
questions.question: To address the issue is important that we act quickly.
